response.query: Which queueing/backpressure model (e.g., network-of-queues, M/G/1/K, G/G/1, fluid approximation) best captures per-bank contention, arbitration stalls and pipeline backpressure for our RM microarchitecture?
response.answer: The network-of-queues model best captures per-bank contention, arbitration stalls, and pipeline backpressure for your RM microarchitecture. This model effectively represents the interactions and delays in a parallel system.
